items.raw_excerpt: Leopard numbers are recovering in western Zambia after communities replaced real leopard skins with synthetic furs for traditional ceremonies, conservationists say.
items.summary_en: People in western Zambia used to use real leopard skins in traditional ceremonies. Communities switched to synthetic furs instead. Now leopard numbers are recovering, conservationists say.
items.summary_ko: 서부 잠비아의 주민들은 전통 의식에 쓰던 표범 가죽을 합성 털로 바꿨다. 보호 활동가들은 이 덕분에 표범 개체수가 다시 늘고 있다고 전한다.
items.title_en: Synthetic furs help Zambia's leopards recover
items.title_ko: 가죽 대신 합성 털, 잠비아 표범 살렸다
items.title_original: Synthetic furs help Zambia’s leopards recover

items.raw_excerpt: The Taste of the Danforth festival has been on hiatus since 2023 after financial shortfalls, but funding from the province and the city helped bring it back, with the federal government announcing additional support just days before it kicked off.
items.summary_en: Toronto's Danforth Avenue food festival is back after a two-year break. It closed in 2023 because of money problems. The province and city gave money to bring it back, and the federal government added more support just days before it started.
items.summary_ko: 토론토 다포스 길에서 열리는 먹거리 축제가 2년 만에 돌아온다. 2023년 재정난으로 중단됐지만, 주와 시 정부의 지원으로 다시 열리게 됐고, 연방 정부도 축제 직전 추가 지원을 약속했다.
items.title_en: Taste of the Danforth festival returns after 2-year break
items.title_original: 'We want it back for another 30 years': Taste of the Danforth returns after 2-year hiatus

items.raw_excerpt: Peneco Beach in Albufeira is unique for several reasons.
items.summary_en: Peneco Beach in Albufeira is unique for several reasons. It is picked as this week's featured beach by the local news. The beach stands out among the beaches of the Algarve region.
items.summary_ko: 알부페이라의 페네코 해변은 여러 가지 이유로 독특합니다. 이 해변은 이번 주의 해변으로 소개되었습니다. 알가르베 지역의 해변들 사이에서 특히 눈에 띕니다.
items.title_en: Beach of the week: Peneco Beach

items.raw_excerpt: It takes years of work, dozens of volunteers, picky pollinators and a special fungus to save Australia’s endangered orchids. Here's why people drive from all over the country to do it anyway.
items.summary_en: A rare orchid in Australia needs years of work and many volunteers to survive. The plant also depends on picky pollinators and a special fungus. That is why people drive from all over the country to help plant it.
items.summary_ko: 호주에 사는 희귀한 난초를 살리려면 여러 해의 노력과 많은 자원봉사자가 필요합니다. 이 난초는 까다로운 수분 매개 곤충과 특별한 균류의 도움도 필요합니다. 그래서 전국 각지에서 사람들이 이 난초를 심으러 차를 몰고 찾아옵니다.
items.title_en: Volunteers race to save one of Australia's rarest orchids

items.title_original: The race is on in a secret location to save one of our rarest orchids

items.raw_excerpt: Sie planen einen Besuch in Österreich? Dann sollte diese Stadt unbedingt auf Ihrer Liste stehen, sie zählt zu den schönsten des Landes
items.summary_en: A ranking names a small Austrian town as the country's most beautiful city. It beats the famous city of Salzburg. Travelers visiting Austria should not miss this town.

items.title_en: A small town beats Salzburg: Austria's most beautiful city
